pdf_object_registration_audit.description: Ground-truth object inventory across all 33 pages of both unseen real CC BY 4.0 complex-layout PDFs for evaluating PDF object registration Recall, Precision, and False-Positive Rate.

matching_rules.visual_panel_and_table: Same page, same semantic class, normalized visible-page bbox IoU >= 0.45 (or >= 0.65 containment of true object with no extraneous cross-column/adjacent-object spill). Multiple registrations of the same GT object count as 1 TP and (k-1) FP.
matching_rules.figure_caption: Same page, matches GT figure caption number and anchor text (prefix/body overlap >= 0.60). Table captions registered as captions are recorded in an explicit secondary bucket and not counted as FP if accurately matching a true table caption.
matching_rules.standalone_formula: Same page, matches GT numbered display equation number and expression anchor. Unnumbered display equations on Speculative-Decoding p4 and p12 are marked allow_optional (neither required for numbered-equation recall nor penalized as FP).

red_line_trigger.rule: If overall micro-Recall < 0.70 OR overall micro-Precision < 0.70 (equivalently overall FPR > 0.30), OR if visual-figure recall < 0.70, OR table recall < 0.70, OR caption/formula precision < 0.70 on these 2 unseen real PDFs, TRIGGER ROUTE RECONSIDERATION RED LINE and escalate to architecture lead before approving heuristic PDFium registration.
